intro: 二端口网络只关心两个端口上的 4 个量 U̇_1、İ_1、U̇_2、İ_2，用两个线性方程把它们联系起来；选哪两个量当自变量，就得到 Z、Y、H、T 四套参数。本章的全部约定：**端口电流从端口的“+”端流入**（与端口电压关联），T 参数方程里出现的是 −İ_2（流向负载的电流）。每个参数都可以“按定义”求：令某个端口开路或短路。

en.intro: A two-port is described only by the four port quantities U̇_1, İ_1, U̇_2, İ_2, related by two linear equations; choosing which two are the independent variables gives the Z, Y, H and T parameters. The convention throughout: **each port current flows into the “+” terminal of its port** (associated with the port voltage); the T-parameter equations use −İ_2 (the current going to the load). Every parameter can be found “by definition”, by opening or shorting one port.

ideas.title: 二端口与参考方向
text: 一个网络有两对端子 1–1'、2–2'，每对满足**端口条件**（从 1 端流入的电流等于从 1' 端流出的电流），就是二端口。本章只讨论内部不含独立源、线性的二端口（可以含受控源）。
约定：u_1（U̇_1）的“+”在 1 端，i_1 从 1 端流入；u_2 的“+”在 2 端，i_2 从 2 端**流入**。直流电阻网络用 u、i，正弦稳态用相量 U̇、İ，参数方程的形式完全一样。

en.title: Two-ports and reference directions
text: A network with two terminal pairs 1–1', 2–2', each satisfying the **port condition** (the current entering terminal 1 equals the current leaving 1'), is a two-port. This chapter covers linear two-ports without independent sources inside (dependent sources allowed).

Convention: u_1 (U̇_1) has “+” at terminal 1 and i_1 enters terminal 1; u_2 has “+” at terminal 2 and i_2 **enters** terminal 2. Resistive DC networks use u, i; sinusoidal steady state uses phasors U̇, İ — the parameter equations look exactly the same.

ideas.title: Z 参数（开路阻抗参数）
text: 按定义求：令 İ_2 = 0（端口 2 **开路**），在端口 1 加电流 İ_1，z_11 = U̇_1/İ_1、z_21 = U̇_2/İ_1；再令 İ_1 = 0 求 z_12、z_22。开路的端口上串联的元件里没有电流、没有压降。
T 形网络的 Z 参数可以直接写：z_11 = Z_1 + Z_3，z_22 = Z_2 + Z_3，z_12 = z_21 = Z_3（Z_3 为公共支路）。含受控源时按定义一步步算，受控源的控制量为零时它相当于短路（电压源）或开路（电流源）。

en.title: Z parameters (open-circuit impedance parameters)
text: With the two port currents as independent variables: U̇_1 = z_11İ_1 + z_12İ_2, U̇_2 = z_21İ_1 + z_22İ_2.

By definition: let İ_2 = 0 (port 2 **open**), drive port 1 with İ_1: z_11 = U̇_1/İ_1, z_21 = U̇_2/İ_1; then let İ_1 = 0 for z_12, z_22. An element in series with an open port carries no current and has no drop.

For a T network write them down directly: z_11 = Z_1 + Z_3, z_22 = Z_2 + Z_3, z_12 = z_21 = Z_3 (Z_3 = the shared branch). With dependent sources go step by step by the definition; a dependent source whose controlling quantity is zero becomes a short (voltage source) or an open (current source).

ideas.title: Y 参数（短路导纳参数）
text: 按定义求：令 U̇_2 = 0（端口 2 **短路**），在端口 1 加电压，y_11 = İ_1/U̇_1、y_21 = İ_2/U̇_1。注意 İ_2 以流入 2 端为正，短路线里的电流实际往外流时 y_21 为负。
Π 形网络的 Y 参数可以直接写：y_11 = Y_a + Y_c，y_22 = Y_b + Y_c，y_12 = y_21 = −Y_c（Y_c 为跨接两端口的串臂）。所以无源**电阻** Π 形网络的 y_12 总是负的（交流时 y_12 = −Y_c 是复数，谈不上正负）。

en.title: Y parameters (short-circuit admittance parameters)
text: With the two port voltages as independent variables: İ_1 = y_11U̇_1 + y_12U̇_2, İ_2 = y_21U̇_1 + y_22U̇_2.

By definition: let U̇_2 = 0 (port 2 **shorted**), drive port 1 with a voltage: y_11 = İ_1/U̇_1, y_21 = İ_2/U̇_1. İ_2 counts positive into terminal 2, so when the short carries current outwards y_21 is negative.

For a Π network write them down directly: y_11 = Y_a + Y_c, y_22 = Y_b + Y_c, y_12 = y_21 = −Y_c (Y_c = the series arm between the ports). So y_12 of a passive **resistive** Π network is always negative (in AC, y_12 = −Y_c is complex and has no sign).

ideas.title: H 参数（混合参数）
text: 以 İ_1、U̇_2 为自变量：U̇_1 = h_11İ_1 + h_12U̇_2，İ_2 = h_21İ_1 + h_22U̇_2。四个参数的量纲各不相同：h_11 是阻抗，h_22 是导纳，h_12、h_21 无量纲。
测量条件是“混合”的：h_11、h_21 令 U̇_2 = 0（输出短路），h_12、h_22 令 İ_1 = 0（输入开路）。晶体管小信号模型就是用 H 参数描述的：h_11 输入电阻、h_12 电压反馈系数、h_21 电流放大倍数 β、h_22 输出电导。

en.title: H parameters (hybrid parameters)
text: With İ_1 and U̇_2 as independent variables: U̇_1 = h_11İ_1 + h_12U̇_2, İ_2 = h_21İ_1 + h_22U̇_2. Their units all differ: h_11 is an impedance, h_22 an admittance, h_12 and h_21 dimensionless.

The test conditions are “hybrid”: h_11, h_21 with U̇_2 = 0 (output shorted), h_12, h_22 with İ_1 = 0 (input open). The small-signal transistor model is written in H parameters: h_11 input resistance, h_12 reverse voltage ratio, h_21 current gain β, h_22 output conductance.

ideas.title: T 参数（传输参数 ABCD）
text: 以输出端的 U̇_2、−İ_2 为自变量：U̇_1 = AU̇_2 − Bİ_2，İ_1 = CU̇_2 − Dİ_2。−İ_2 就是从 2 端流出、流向负载的电流——这是 T 参数方程里出现负号的原因，不是另一种参考方向。
三个基本单元：串联阻抗 Z 的 T = [1 Z; 0 1]，并联导纳 Y 的 T = [1 0; Y 1]，理想变压器 n:1 的 T = [n 0; 0 1/n]。

en.title: T parameters (transmission parameters ABCD)
text: With the output quantities U̇_2 and −İ_2 as independent variables: U̇_1 = AU̇_2 − Bİ_2, İ_1 = CU̇_2 − Dİ_2. −İ_2 is the current leaving terminal 2 towards the load — that is where the minus sign comes from; it is not a different reference direction.
By definition: A = U̇_1/U̇_2, C = İ_1/U̇_2 (port 2 open, İ_2 = 0); B = U̇_1/(−İ_2), D = İ_1/(−İ_2) (port 2 shorted, U̇_2 = 0). A, D are dimensionless, B an impedance, C an admittance.
Three building blocks: series impedance Z, T = [1 Z; 0 1]; shunt admittance Y, T = [1 0; Y 1]; ideal transformer n:1, T = [n 0; 0 1/n].

ideas.title: 互易与对称
text: 只由线性 R、L、C（及耦合电感、理想变压器）组成的二端口是**互易**的：z_12 = z_21，y_12 = y_21，h_12 = −h_21，AD − BC = 1。互易二端口只有 3 个独立参数。
互易且两个端口互换后外特性不变的叫**对称**二端口：还要求 z_11 = z_22（y_11 = y_22，A = D）。结构对称的网络一定电气对称。
含受控源的网络一般**不互易**（z_12 ≠ z_21），这时需要 4 个参数，也不能用只有 3 个元件的 T 形、Π 形无源电路等效。

en.title: Reciprocity and symmetry
text: A two-port made only of linear R, L, C (and coupled inductors, ideal transformers) is **reciprocal**: z_12 = z_21, y_12 = y_21, h_12 = −h_21, AD − BC = 1. A reciprocal two-port has only 3 independent parameters.

If in addition the ports can be swapped without changing anything seen from outside, it is **symmetric**: also z_11 = z_22 (y_11 = y_22, A = D). A structurally symmetric network is always electrically symmetric.
Networks with dependent sources are generally **not reciprocal** (z_12 ≠ z_21): they need all 4 parameters and cannot be replaced by a passive three-element T or Π circuit.

ideas.title: 参数之间的换算
text: Z 与 Y 互为逆矩阵：Y = Z^{−1}，例如 y_11 = z_22/Δ_Z，y_12 = −z_12/Δ_Z，Δ_Z = z_11z_22 − z_12z_21。复数参数也一样，按复数运算。
换算前先想清楚：最容易“按定义”或“直接写出”的是哪一套参数（T 形先写 Z，Π 形先写 Y），再换算到题目要的那套。某套参数可能不存在（例如 Δ_Z = 0 时没有 Y 参数）。

en.title: Converting between parameter sets
text: Z and Y are inverse matrices: Y = Z^{−1}, e.g. y_11 = z_22/Δ_Z, y_12 = −z_12/Δ_Z with Δ_Z = z_11z_22 − z_12z_21. Complex parameters work the same way with complex arithmetic.

Before converting, decide which set is easiest to get by definition or by inspection (Z for a T network, Y for a Π network), then convert to the set asked for. Some sets may not exist (e.g. no Y parameters when Δ_Z = 0).

ideas.title: 等效电路：T 形与 Π 形
text: 互易二端口有 3 个独立参数，所以总能用 3 个元件等效。**T 形**（由 Z 参数）：两个串臂 Z_1 = z_11 − z_12、Z_2 = z_22 − z_12，并臂 Z_3 = z_12。**Π 形**（由 Y 参数）：两个并臂 Y_a = y_11 + y_12、Y_b = y_22 + y_12，串臂 Y_c = −y_12。
等效出来的元件值可能为负（只是数学模型）。格形（桥形）、桥 T 形这类网络先求参数，再套用上面的公式化成 T 形或 Π 形。

en.title: Equivalent circuits: T and Π
text: A reciprocal two-port has 3 independent parameters, so three elements can always represent it. **T** (from Z): series arms Z_1 = z_11 − z_12, Z_2 = z_22 − z_12, shunt arm Z_3 = z_12. **Π** (from Y): shunt arms Y_a = y_11 + y_12, Y_b = y_22 + y_12, series arm Y_c = −y_12.
The equivalent element values may be negative (it is only a model). For lattice (bridge) or bridged-T networks, find the parameters first, then use these formulas.

ideas.title: 二端口的连接：级联、并联
text: **级联**（前一级的输出端口接后一级的输入端口）：前一级的 −İ_2 正好是后一级的 İ_1，所以 **T = T_1T_2**——矩阵乘法，顺序从输入到输出，不能交换。
**并联**（两个端口分别并联）：Y = Y_1 + Y_2；**串联**：Z = Z_1 + Z_2。并联、串联相加的前提是连接后每个子二端口仍满足端口条件（例如有公共接地线的三端网络并联总是成立）。
把复杂网络拆成串臂、并臂、理想变压器这样的基本单元再相乘，是求 T 参数最快的办法。

en.title: Connecting two-ports: cascade and parallel
text: **Cascade** (the output port of one stage feeds the input port of the next): −İ_2 of the first stage is İ_1 of the second, so **T = T_1T_2** — a matrix product, from input to output, and the order cannot be swapped.

**Parallel** (ports connected in parallel pairwise): Y = Y_1 + Y_2; **series**: Z = Z_1 + Z_2. Adding is valid only if each sub-two-port still satisfies the port condition after connecting (always true for three-terminal networks sharing a common ground line in parallel).
Splitting a network into series arms, shunt arms and ideal transformers and multiplying their T matrices is the quickest way to its T parameters.

ideas.title: 端接电源与负载
text: 端口 2 接负载 Z_L 时 U̇_2 = −Z_Lİ_2（İ_2 流入 2 端，负载电流是 −İ_2）。把它代入参数方程消去 U̇_2、İ_2，得到从端口 1 看进去的输入阻抗：Z_in = (AZ_L + B)/(CZ_L + D) = z_11 − z_12z_21/(z_22 + Z_L)。
从端口 2 看进去的戴维宁等效（端口 1 接 U̇_s、内阻 Z_s）：开路电压在 İ_2 = 0 时求，U̇_oc = z_21U̇_s/(z_11 + Z_s)；等效阻抗 Z_eq = z_22 − z_12z_21/(z_11 + Z_s)。
端接问题本质上是 4 个方程（2 个参数方程 + 2 个端接条件）解 4 个未知数，记不住公式时直接联立即可。

en.title: Terminating a two-port with a source and a load
text: With a load Z_L on port 2, U̇_2 = −Z_Lİ_2 (İ_2 enters terminal 2, the load current is −İ_2). Substituting into the parameter equations gives the input impedance seen at port 1: Z_in = (AZ_L + B)/(CZ_L + D) = z_11 − z_12z_21/(z_22 + Z_L).

The Thevenin equivalent seen at port 2 (port 1 driven by U̇_s with internal Z_s): open-circuit voltage with İ_2 = 0, U̇_oc = z_21U̇_s/(z_11 + Z_s); equivalent impedance Z_eq = z_22 − z_12z_21/(z_11 + Z_s).
A terminated two-port is just 4 equations (2 parameter equations + 2 termination conditions) in 4 unknowns — if you forget the formulas, solve them together directly.

formulas.name: Z 参数方程
formulas.when: 线性、无独立源；İ_1、İ_2 都从端口“+”端流入。z_12、z_22 在 İ_1 = 0（端口 1 开路）时求。

en.name: Z-parameter equations
en.when: Linear, no independent sources; İ_1, İ_2 both enter the “+” terminal of their port. z_12, z_22 with İ_1 = 0 (port 1 open).

formulas.name: Y 参数方程
formulas.when: 同上的参考方向；y_12、y_22 在 U̇_1 = 0（端口 1 短路）时求。

en.name: Y-parameter equations
en.when: Same reference directions; y_12, y_22 with U̇_1 = 0 (port 1 shorted).

en.name: H-parameter equations
en.when: h_11, h_21: U̇_2 = 0 (output shorted); h_12, h_22: İ_1 = 0 (input open). İ_2 enters terminal 2.

formulas.name: T 参数方程
formulas.when: İ_2 仍以流入 2 端为正，−İ_2 是流向负载的电流。A、C：İ_2 = 0（端口 2 开路）；B、D：U̇_2 = 0（端口 2 短路）。

en.name: T-parameter equations
en.when: İ_2 still counts positive into terminal 2; −İ_2 is the current to the load. A, C: İ_2 = 0 (port 2 open); B, D: U̇_2 = 0 (port 2 shorted).

formulas.name: 基本单元的 T 矩阵
formulas.when: 按从端口 1 到端口 2 的顺序排列；理想变压器的同名端在两个端口的“+”端。

en.name: T matrices of the building blocks
en.expr: series Z: [1 Z; 0 1]; shunt Y: [1 0; Y 1]; ideal transformer n:1: [n 0; 0 1/n]
en.when: Ordered from port 1 to port 2; the transformer's dotted ends at the “+” terminals of the two ports.

formulas.name: 互易 / 对称条件
formulas.when: 只含线性 R、L、C、耦合电感、理想变压器的网络一定互易；含受控源时一般不互易。

en.name: Reciprocity / symmetry
en.expr: reciprocal: z_12 = z_21, y_12 = y_21, h_12 = −h_21, AD − BC = 1; symmetric: also z_11 = z_22 (A = D)
en.when: Networks of linear R, L, C, coupled inductors and ideal transformers are always reciprocal; with dependent sources generally not.

en.name: Z ↔ Y
en.when: Δ_Z = z_11z_22 − z_12z_21 ≠ 0; Z = Y^{−1} has the same form.

formulas.name: T 形等效
formulas.when: 互易二端口（z_12 = z_21）；Z_1 接端口 1、Z_2 接端口 2、Z_3 为公共并臂。

en.name: T equivalent
en.when: Reciprocal two-port (z_12 = z_21); Z_1 at port 1, Z_2 at port 2, Z_3 the common shunt arm.

formulas.name: Π 形等效
formulas.when: 互易二端口（y_12 = y_21）；Y_a、Y_b 为端口 1、2 的并臂，Y_c 为跨接两端口的串臂。

en.name: Π equivalent
en.when: Reciprocal two-port (y_12 = y_21); Y_a, Y_b the shunt arms at ports 1 and 2, Y_c the series arm between them.

formulas.name: 级联、并联、串联
formulas.expr: 级联 T = T_1T_2；并联 Y = Y_1 + Y_2；串联 Z = Z_1 + Z_2
formulas.when: 级联按从输入到输出的顺序相乘；并联、串联要求连接后各子网络仍满足端口条件。

en.name: Cascade, parallel, series
en.expr: cascade T = T_1T_2; parallel Y = Y_1 + Y_2; series Z = Z_1 + Z_2
en.when: Cascade: multiply from input to output; parallel/series: each sub-network must still satisfy the port condition after connecting.

formulas.name: 输入阻抗
formulas.when: 端口 2 接负载 Z_L：U̇_2 = −Z_Lİ_2（İ_2 流入 2 端）。

en.name: Input impedance
en.when: Load Z_L on port 2: U̇_2 = −Z_Lİ_2 (İ_2 enters terminal 2).

formulas.name: 输出端戴维宁等效
formulas.when: 端口 1 接电压源 U̇_s 与内阻抗 Z_s 串联（U̇_1 = U̇_s − Z_sİ_1）；U̇_oc 在端口 2 开路（İ_2 = 0）时求。

en.name: Thevenin equivalent at the output
en.when: Port 1 driven by U̇_s in series with Z_s (U̇_1 = U̇_s − Z_sİ_1); U̇_oc with port 2 open (İ_2 = 0).

examples.title: T 形网络：Z 参数，再换算成 Y、T 参数
examples.statement: 图示 T 形电阻二端口中，R_1 = 1 Ω，R_2 = 2 Ω，R_3 = 3 Ω。端口电流 i_1、i_2 都从 1、2 端流入。求 Z 参数，再由它换算出 Y 参数中的 y_11、y_12 和 T 参数 A、B、C、D，并验证互易条件。
steps: 注意：网络不对称（z_11 ≠ z_22，A ≠ D），因为 R_1 ≠ R_2。

en.title: T network: Z parameters, then Y and T by conversion
en.statement: In the resistive T two-port, R_1 = 1 Ω, R_2 = 2 Ω, R_3 = 3 Ω. The port currents i_1, i_2 enter terminals 1 and 2. Find the Z parameters, convert them to y_11, y_12 and to the T parameters A, B, C, D, and check reciprocity.
steps: 1. **Z parameters by definition.** With port 2 open (i_2 = 0) no current flows in R_2 and i_1 goes through R_1 and R_3: u_1 = (R_1 + R_3)i_1, u_2 = R_3i_1, so z_11 = **4 Ω** and z_21 = **3 Ω**. Likewise with port 1 open: z_22 = R_2 + R_3 = **5 Ω**, z_12 = R_3 = **3 Ω**.
4. **Check reciprocity:** z_12 = z_21 and AD − BC = 20/9 − 11/9 = 1 ✓. A can also be checked by its definition: with port 2 open, u_1/u_2 = (R_1 + R_3)/R_3 = 4/3.
Note: the network is not symmetric (z_11 ≠ z_22, A ≠ D) because R_1 ≠ R_2.

examples.title: 端接电源和负载：输入电阻与输出端戴维宁等效
examples.statement: 把上一例的 T 形二端口（z_11 = 4 Ω，z_12 = z_21 = 3 Ω，z_22 = 5 Ω）端口 1 接 U_s = 10 V、内阻 R_s = 1 Ω 的电源，端口 2 接负载 R_L = 4 Ω。求输入电阻 R_in（含 R_L）、电流 i_1、负载电压 u_2，以及断开 R_L 后从端口 2 看进去的戴维宁等效电路。
steps: 1. **端接条件。** u_1 = U_s − R_si_1，u_2 = −R_Li_2（i_2 流入 2 端，负载电流是 −i_2）。

en.title: A terminated two-port: input resistance and Thevenin equivalent at the output
en.statement: The T two-port of the previous example (z_11 = 4 Ω, z_12 = z_21 = 3 Ω, z_22 = 5 Ω) is driven at port 1 by U_s = 10 V with internal resistance R_s = 1 Ω and loaded at port 2 by R_L = 4 Ω. Find the input resistance R_in (with R_L), the current i_1, the load voltage u_2, and the Thevenin equivalent seen at port 2 with R_L removed.
steps: 1. **Termination conditions.** u_1 = U_s − R_si_1, u_2 = −R_Li_2 (i_2 enters terminal 2, so the load current is −i_2).
2. **Input resistance.** With T parameters: R_in = (AR_L + B)/(CR_L + D) = (16/3 + 11/3)/(4/3 + 5/3) = 9/3 = **3 Ω**; with Z parameters: R_in = z_11 − z_12z_21/(z_22 + R_L) = 4 − 9/9, the same.
4. **Load voltage.** From the second Z equation and u_2 = −R_Li_2: i_2 = −z_21i_1/(z_22 + R_L) = −7.5/9, u_2 = −4i_2 = **3.333 V**.
5. **Thevenin equivalent at the output.** With R_L removed (i_2 = 0): i_1 = U_s/(R_s + z_11) = 10/5 = 2, u_oc = z_21i_1 = **6 V**; R_eq = z_22 − z_12z_21/(z_11 + R_s) = 5 − 9/5 = **3.2 Ω**.

mistakes.text: 把 i_2 当成从 2 端流出的电流。本章约定 i_2 **流入** 2 端；端口 2 接负载时负载电流是 −i_2，u_2 = −R_Li_2。y_21、h_21 等参数的正负都取决于这个方向。

en.text: Taking i_2 as the current leaving terminal 2. By convention i_2 **enters** terminal 2; with a load on port 2 the load current is −i_2 and u_2 = −R_Li_2. The signs of y_21, h_21 etc. depend on this direction.

mistakes.text: 求参数时用错了端口条件：Z 参数要令另一端口**开路**，Y 参数要令另一端口**短路**，H 参数两种都有（h_11、h_21 输出短路，h_12、h_22 输入开路）。先写出参数的定义式，再看分母里的量和“= 0”的量。

en.text: Using the wrong test condition: Z parameters need the other port **open**, Y parameters the other port **shorted**, H parameters both (h_11, h_21 output shorted; h_12, h_22 input open). Write the defining ratio first and look at what is in the denominator and what is set to zero.

mistakes.text: 以为 y_11 = 1/z_11。Y 是 Z 的**逆矩阵**，y_11 = z_22/Δ_Z；只有当 z_12 = z_21 = 0 时才退化成倒数。

en.text: Thinking y_11 = 1/z_11. Y is the **inverse matrix** of Z: y_11 = z_22/Δ_Z; it reduces to a reciprocal only when z_12 = z_21 = 0.

mistakes.text: T 参数方程写成 u_1 = Au_2 + Bi_2，或求 B、D 时用 i_2 代替 −i_2，结果差一个负号。B = u_1/(−i_2)、D = i_1/(−i_2)，都在端口 2 短路时求，无源电阻网络的 B、D 为正。

en.text: Writing u_1 = Au_2 + Bi_2, or using i_2 instead of −i_2 for B and D, which flips the sign. B = u_1/(−i_2) and D = i_1/(−i_2), both with port 2 shorted; for passive resistive networks B and D are positive.

mistakes.text: 级联时把 T 矩阵的乘法顺序弄反，或者把各级的 Z 参数直接相加。级联只能用 T = T_1T_2（从输入到输出）；Z 相加对应的是串联连接，Y 相加对应并联连接。

en.text: Multiplying the T matrices in the wrong order for a cascade, or adding the stages' Z parameters. A cascade needs T = T_1T_2 (input to output); adding Z means a series connection, adding Y a parallel one.

mistakes.text: 含受控源的网络也默认 z_12 = z_21，只算一个就完事，或者硬套 T 形等效。受控源一般破坏互易性，四个参数都要按定义算。

en.text: Assuming z_12 = z_21 for a network with dependent sources and computing only one of them, or forcing a T equivalent. Dependent sources generally break reciprocity; compute all four parameters by definition.
